SRC-212:R001.text: Reproduce the active VERIFY admission incident in disposable protocol fixtures; distinguish reproduced behavior from the reported SAI_WEBSITE history, and preserve any newer live authority before mutation.

SRC-212:R002.text: Inspect the documented CLI and runtime contract before choosing the repair; never invent verbs merely because a consumer attempted them.

SRC-212:R003.text: Repair a supported evidence-admission route, or document a compatible operation only where the contract requires one, so genuine regression evidence is admissible while Work is active in VERIFY.

SRC-212:R004.text: Keep pre-fix failure and post-fix success distinct and bind their correct ticket, attempt, unchanged verifier, source identity and chronological execution.

SRC-212:R005.text: Make REVIEW evaluate current authoritative evidence; newer failure or authority must supersede stale approval.

SRC-212:R006.text: Reject forged, unrelated, out-of-order, contradictory and unrecognized-verifier evidence without weakening lifecycle gates.

SRC-212:R007.text: Preserve historical event chains and previously valid records and lifecycle flows.

SRC-212:R008.text: Return clear refusal codes and the permitted recovery route when admission is unavailable.

SRC-212:R009.text: Negative control: missing genuine regression pair refuses admission.

SRC-212:R010.text: Negative control: failure and success from unrelated attempts refuse admission.

SRC-212:R011.text: Negative control: stale evidence superseded by newer authority cannot approve REVIEW.

SRC-212:R012.text: Negative control: unrecognized verifier identity refuses admission.
